summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The candidate changes no runtime or native code. Its GPU regression validly covers fresh lazy allocation, speculative boundary planning, TARGET_VERIFY index construction, and confirmed-boundary promotion/freeing against source fixes already present in the recorded base. Independent no-boundary, allocation-failure, pending-slot-reuse, and window-edge cases passed. Full original-issue resolution remains unverified without an end-to-end hybrid-mamba NEXTN run on the reported NVIDIA topology.

tests.command: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ff0fa4b64fc2/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... historical expression and actual base helper ... PY
tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, the historical unguarded torch.tensor expression raised the reported TypeError, while the actual source helper selected position 0 and GPU slot 101 without mutating the request's None field.
The exact candidate's four GPU tests passed, including the lifecycle test for allocation, verify index selection, and boundary promotion/freeing.

Four independent GPU adversarial cases passed: no reachable boundary performs no allocation, allocation failure falls back in place, an existing pending slot is reused, and a boundary exactly at the lookahead window is allocated and selected.
Adjacent scheduler/result-processing coverage passed: 3 tests and 2 subtests.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed candidate and adversarial tensors on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0.

remaining_counterexamples: No end-to-end fresh-request NEXTN TARGET_VERIFY serving run was performed on a hybrid-mamba model.
Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 weights and the reported two RTX 3090 GPUs were unavailable; NVIDIA and multi-GPU behavior remain unverified.
The candidate validates scheduler/cache allocation and speculative boundary lifecycle with GPU tensors, but not hybrid-mamba kernel semantics, model accuracy, HTTP serving, or distributed execution.
remaining_limitations: The available accelerator was one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), not the reported two NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs.
The required Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 weights were unavailable.
The tiny Llama serving fixture is not hybrid-mamba and was not used as proof.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
